title: Low Glycemic French Choux Gougere
description: A French-inspired savory pastry made with low glycemic ingredients and choux for a delightful side dish or snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll out the choux pastry dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Transfer the dough to the baking sheet, trimming edges to fit.
Brush the dough with bacon fat or unsalted butter.
Sprinkle the Gruyère cheese evenly over the dough.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped thyme.
Cut into desired shapes or serve as is.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
